module Test.WHL.07

function bad_while_cond(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n >= 0
is
    let i: Integer = 0
    while i
    invariant i >= 0
    variant n - i
    do
        i := i + 1
    end while
    return i
end bad_while_cond

end Test.WHL.07
